narrative.details:
Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.

Venture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, champion. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.
narrative.offerRewardText: Varimathras would be proud. You serve your leaders well, Champion.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, Champion?

quests.name: The Damned
quests.objectiveText: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.

quests.objectiveText: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.

quests.name: The Scarlet Crusade
quests.objectiveText: Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.

quests.name: The Red Messenger
quests.objectiveText: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.

quests.name: Vital Intelligence
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.

quests.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.objectiveText: Executor Zygand of Brill wants you to kill 10 Scarlet Warriors.
